Bofors of Swedish design was largely appreciated throughout the world, c' is l' one of the rare weapons that l' one can find as well at the allies as at the forces of l' center. Thanks to its system d' provisioning, it could have an impressive frequency of shooting without s' to stop to reload. Bofors requires 2 people to be handled. That of right-hand side to the load of the system of rotation of l' arms, while that of left s' occupy of the mechanism of rise and shooting by using the pedals. One needs usually 2 people to sufficiently quickly reload the 4 clips of ammunition in the gun.
In Battleground Europe, Bofors is an extraordinary weapon as well against targets on the ground qu' air.
L' crew 1, the commander, has 2 levels of enlargement on the target. L' crew 2 looks through the test card. This test card is particularly useful against the air targets moving quickly but the lack of enlargement at the station of gunner is particularly awkward when l' one engages a target with long distance on the ground, especially if it is more or less camouflaged.
When you make use of Bofors against planes be aggressive. You have ammunition enormously, not d' stop to reload, and a shooting very tended with little fall for l' shell jusqu' with 2Km. If l' enemy plane has a gray circle around him, draw! The number of revolutions of the gun is very fast, you can engage a plane at short distance and follow it in its displacement without any difficulty.
Against targets on the ground, you will note that the dispersion of the shells of 40 mm is raised enough, and you will need to sprinkle your target well. The high-explosive shells of 40mm (HE) do not penetrate well the shielding, but l' effect of the explosions will shake your target qu' so much; it will have much evil to align you in his sight.
As a heavy gun, Bofors can be moved manually only very slowly. It is preferable to find a truck being able to tractor draw you jusqu' a site offering has a beautiful field of fire. A very good place is for example on a hill, just in lower part of the top: In this position you will not be a silhouette on l' horizon and d' other share will enable you to reduce your surveillance zone of 180°, and if you are threatened by a infantry or another thing you n' will have more qu' to give you in position of displacement. (This will then enable you to kill the slope while rolling, you moving away thus from the hot sector and you n' will have more qu' has to redeploy you to stop you.)
To think well of a thing, you n' do not have protection to be to you thus very vulnerable to all sniper passing near you.
